name: comp-484
title: Table With Ellipsis Pagination
blurb: Paginated table with numbered page buttons and ellipsis between page ranges.
description: Data table with smart pagination showing numbered page buttons (5 at a time), ellipsis for skipped ranges, previous/next buttons, and rows-per-page selector. Includes aria-live updates and aria-current on active page.
use_when: Tables with many pages where users want to jump to specific page numbers, not just next/previous.
avoid_when: Very large datasets (1000+ pages) — even with ellipsis, pagination buttons overwhelm the UI.
a11y: Page buttons have aria-current="page" when active. Previous/next buttons have aria-labels. Page info uses aria-live="polite".
